summary: Steel tower on an island in Nipissing District, Ontario, shown on a 1963 Lands and Forests map; the register says a tornado destroyed it in 1969.

facts.status_note: Register says a tornado destroyed the tower in 1969; no second source found

staffing.status: manned by towerman Finlay Gillies, recorded 1931 to 1947 and possibly longer

facts.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests (named on the 1963 Tower Detection System Map the register cites)

events.note: Towerman Finlay Gillies is recorded as manning the tower from 1931 (register)
1947 is the end of the period the register gives for Gillies; it adds 'possibly beyond'
Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map shows a 100 foot steel tower at this location; the tower does not appear on Sudbury topographic map 41-I (register)

notes_for_editor: Everything rests on one register entry (firelookout.ca, credited to Jeff Gilbert). The 1969 tornado date has no second source; I did not find a 1969 Nipissing tornado in the Wikipedia list of pre-2000 Canadian tornadoes that I checked, though the list's 1970 Sudbury F3 is a different event. The Sylva Magazine profile and the 1963 map were cited by the register but not read. The Bear Island link is the register's own suggestion and was not searched. Access and site condition are unknown; the story says so.
